NUNN SERIES
The Nunn series consists of deep, nearly level to moderately steep, well-drained soils on fans, terraces, and footslopes in valleys. Slopes range from 0 to 15 percent. They formed in silty clay loam alluvium along intermittent streams at elevations of 3300 to 3700 feet.
Vegetation is mainly blue grama, green needlegrass, western wheatgrass, and silver sage. Annual precipitation is 14 to 15 inches, mean annual soil temperature is 46 to 47 degrees F., the frost free season is 105 to 120 days.
Typically, the surface layer is grayish brown silty clay loam about 8 inches thick. The subsoil is grayish brown and light olive brown silty clay and clay loam about 15 inches thick. The substratum is stratified clay loam, silt loam, and sandy clay loam to 60 or more inches.
The permeability is slow, the effective rooting depth is 60 or more inches. The available water holding capacity is 8 to 10 inches.
These soils are used for dry cropland and range. They are suited for irrigation.
A typical profile of Nunn silty clay loam in cropland, 480 feet east of S1/4 corner, of Sec. 26, T. 1 N., R. 38 E.
Apl 0 to 3 inches, grayish brown (2.5Y 5/2) silty clay loam, very dark grayish brown (2.5Y 3/2) moist; cloddy; slightly hard, friable, slightly sticky and plastic; abrupt smooth boundary.
Ap2 3 to 8 inches, grayish brown (2.5Y 5/2) silty clay loam, very dark grayish brown (2.5Y 3/2) moist; cloddy; hard, friable, sticky and plastic; abrupt smooth boundary.
8 to 13 inches, grayish brown (2.5Y 5/2) silty clay, dark grayish brown (2.5Y 4/2) moist; moderate, medium prismatic structure parting to strong medium blocks; very hard, firm, very sticky and very plastic; moderately thick, patchy clay films on ped surfaces; clear smooth boundary.
B23t 13 to 17 inches, light olive brown (2.5Y 5/3) silty clay, olive brown (2.5Y 4/3) moist; moderate medium prismatic structure parting to strong medium blocks; very hard, firm, very sticky and very plastic; thin patchy clay films on ped surfaces; clear wavy boundary. (B2t horizon is 9 to 17 inches thick)
B3 17 to 23 inches, light olive brown (2.5Y 5/3) clay loam, olive brown (2.5Y 4/3) moist; moderate, medium subangular blocky structure; very hard, firm, sticky and very plastic; strongly effervescent; clear wavy boundary.
